title.value: On the Convergence of Stochastic Extragradient for Bilinear Games using Restarted Iteration Averaging
title.justification: The title is clearly mentioned multiple times throughout the text, including in the header of each page and in the introduction section.
title.quote: On the Convergence of Stochastic Extragradient for Bilinear Games using Restarted Iteration Averaging

analysis.description: The paper presents an analysis of the stochastic bilinear minimax optimization problem using the same-sample Stochastic Extragradient (SEG) method with constant step size. It introduces variations of the method using iteration averaging and scheduled restarting to achieve optimal convergence rates, particularly focusing on the bilinear game setting and interpolation settings where noise vanishes at the Nash equilibrium. The work is both theoretical and empirical, providing convergence rate improvements over existing methods and validating these with numerical experiments.
